findings.summary: No single Lean predicate is M_α. MeanClass states only clause (iv) plus smoothness; descent and shell support are separate predicates (PeriodicOn, SupportedOn / RadiallySupported, bundled as MovingField), conjoined with MeanClass where M_α is used.

Clause (i) is encoded as unit-lattice periodicity of one global lift in the torus variable, not as an identity between two chart representatives conjugated by J_g^{i0(U)} and J_g^{i0(V)}. The repository has no declaration of the (6.20) shape.

On the main-chain strip the radial variable is the profile radius r = R/√q̃, not X. Since X ∝ r², the Lean edge exponents are a quarter of the paper's and δ_Lean ∈ [δ/2, δ]; the repository itself states the identification.

S_α is stated under a different name and in a different file (MeanMomentBounds.GlobalBandJets), while a docstring applies the name 'S_α' to UnweightedClass over an arbitrary strip, where the majorant still carries (slow·max 1 δ⁻¹)^p.
